assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D pixel-art JRPG character animation atlas. Reference image: ArenBattle.png is character identity, palette, pixel rendering and outfit reference ONLY. Create a NEW animation of this SAME blond hero, red scarf/cape, tan tunic and brown leather gloves/boots, facing LEFT. EXACTLY FOUR fully separated frames in one horizontal row on a wide 3:1 transparent canvas. Same character size in all frames, entire body visible with generous empty alpha margins and gutters. No swords, no shield, no fire or magic effects: only the hero. Frame 1: beginning to lift off ground, chest pushed boldly forward to LEFT, BOTH arms drawn behind his torso toward RIGHT, hands open, head looking left/up. Frame 2: airborne, sternum thrust forward to left, back arched, shoulders pulled back, BOTH arms extended trailing behind him to RIGHT and down, legs trailing/bent at knees, cape behind. Frame 3: main airborne absorption pose, CHEST thrust toward LEFT and upward, BOTH arms unmistakably stretched BACK behind shoulders toward RIGHT (not forward, not crossed), legs gently bent and dangling behind, face looking left. Frame 4: same airborne open-chest arms-back pose, slightly recovering with legs lowered for descent. Clear anatomical readability at small game scale; maintain reference hero identity and chibi 16-bit sprite proportions. Crisp square pixel clusters, limited palette shade ramps, dark pixel outlines. NO 3D, no rendered lighting, no blurry gradients, no ground, no scene, no extra characters, no lettering or grid. True transparent background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D sprite animation atlas for fire ENERGY TRANSFER. Input TyrantMeteorCharge.png is fire color and crisp pixel-art style reference only. Create EXACTLY FOUR effect-only frames in one horizontal row on a wide 3:1 true transparent canvas, generously separated by empty alpha gutters, each entire effect inside its own equal-width cell. Each frame contains THREE slender, distinct, wavy horizontal ribbons of fire flowing from LEFT to RIGHT, converging together to a tiny bright point at RIGHT. The LEFT ends spread vertically, the RIGHT ends taper to one absorption point. Ribbons stretch gracefully across each cell, with large transparent gaps BETWEEN them; visibly thin fiery strips, not a solid beam or cone. Frame 1 ribbons curl gently, frame 2 upper/lower strips bow further, frame 3 strips flutter as they stream, frame 4 alternate wave. Crisp hand-pixeled orange/red edges, yellow-white narrow inner streaks, tiny ember tips, sharp stepped pixels. Flat 16-bit JRPG pixel-art VFX matching the reference, no 3D rendering, no blur or airbrush glow. No fireball, meteor, rock, hands, character, armor emblem, ground, scene, text or grid. Energy ribbons ONLY, no background. All four frame effects same orientation left-to-right and same overall extent; transparent margins on all sides.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: 2D pixel-art sprites for separating a casting animation into layers. Edit target/reference TyrantMeteorCharge.png. Use ONLY its FOURTH/rightmost pose as the exact reference. Produce a transparent wide 2:1 canvas with EXACTLY TWO separated sprites, generous alpha margins. LEFT HALF: the same full-body crowned grey-bearded king in exactly that rightmost casting pose, holding his gold mace in lowered left hand and right palm raised facing up, looking right; REMOVE ONLY the fireball from above the raised palm. Preserve the crown, violet eyes, purple/cream/gold coat, fur shoulder trim, raised brown leather glove/palm and boots, crisp pixel style and original chibi proportions. The raised palm is empty and remains fully visible. RIGHT HALF: the SAME bright red/orange/yellow swirling FIREBALL removed from that fourth pose, now fully isolated, complete circular swirling flame silhouette with white/yellow center, and NO hand/king/body. Keep its exact pixel-art visual identity, palette, and relative size: orb diameter roughly two-thirds the king's body height. Keep both subjects entire and separate, consistent original pixels style. NO rocky comet/meteor, no new object, no scenery, no 3D, no gradients or blur, no ground shadow, no text/grid. True transparent background. This is one layered sprite asset: empty-handed casting king at left, his original fireball at right.
